narrative.overview: Collex combines the user's Apple-inspired restraint with the density and scanability of a stock-market board. Cool surfaces, graphite text and compact financial rows keep the invoice ledger central. This is an operational workspace with plain language and minimal decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet horizontal navigation and flat surfaces.
Blue actions with semantic red, green and amber status.
Evidence and human review available from invoice details.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Use red and green for actual collection states, never invented market movement.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Preserve invoice identity, account context and readable balances when adapting the board to phones.

dos: Do prioritize dense, aligned invoice rows over large summary cards.
Do preserve the offline system-font stack and tabular financial figures.
Do retain readable status words, visible keyboard focus and explicit review controls.
Do keep invoice identity, account context and balance available on phones.
donts: Don't add invented price movement, pulsing decoration or chart filler to the invoice board. The user-requested plush companion belongs only in the Ask panel.
Don't replace restrained chrome with large icon tiles or decorative gradients.
Don't use color alone to convey collection state.
